result.brief: 提出反事实空间想象（CSI）任务与 FlowBench 数据集，用于训练和评测 VLM 与世界模型的假设运动结果预测，并验证仿真到真实的迁移。
result.reason: Builds a benchmark/training resource for counterfactual spatial imagination, improving VLM spatial reasoning and world-model text-to-flow prediction; touches world modeling and spatial representation.
